_: The words a `nothing` line may never say (#451; docs/modules/solitaire-agile.md, "The file shape, and how a standup is read"). Config/standup-vocabulary.json's nothing family is a worker's status on a day with nothing on the tracker: the day around the work, never anything the tracker would show. Both halves -- tkTestToolkit -Rituals and Tests/test_rituals.py -- read this ONE list and refuse a nothing line that holds any of these as a whole word, ignoring case (a phrase matches with any run of spaces between its words), and assert the family has more than one line and no line twice. `fix` and `fixed` are not here on purpose: 'Fixed my standing desk' is a fix to the day, not to code, and a fix to code is a bug, a commit or a pull request, which the list already refuses.
